content.answer: Managed WordPress hosting means your host looks after the technical work behind your website: the servers, backups, security and updates. You keep control of your content and your business. It suits owners who want a reliable site without learning server administration.

content.h2: What is included on the platform
Reach a person when you need one

items.a: Managed WordPress hosting means the host looks after the server your site runs on, so you can focus on your content and your customers. DronaHost offers it on its WordPress hosting plans. If you want to know what is included before you buy, ask the team by support ticket or email.

items.q: Do I need technical skills to use DronaHost?
items.a: No. You manage your site in WordPress as usual, and we handle the technical side.

No. Email is not hosted on DronaHost servers, and Business Hosting does not include email. Your hosting and your email are separate, so you will need an email service from another provider. If you are unsure which option fits, write to the team before you buy.

items.q: Can I move my existing WordPress site to DronaHost?
items.a: Yes, you can move your existing WordPress site to DronaHost. Moving is free on every package. Each hosting package includes the move of one website, and a VPS includes up to 10 websites. The migration terms page explains what is covered. To start, open the free migration page.

items.q: How much does WordPress hosting cost at DronaHost?
Will the price go up when my plan renews?
items.a: No. The hosting price does not change on renewal, because the renewal price equals the signup price. Each plan shows its renewal price next to its signup price. The pricing policy has the full terms. Prices exclude tax. Customers in India pay GST at checkout.

items.q: What if I am not happy with my plan?
items.a: DronaHost offers a 30-day money-back guarantee. The refund policy sets out the exact terms, so please read it before you buy. If you have a question about the guarantee, contact the team by support ticket or email.
You can reach the team by support ticket or email. Tickets and email are the only support channels we offer. The support policy explains how support works, so read it for the details.
